rationale: The message delivers concrete probe results about cat/join/table behavior, providing observed implementation details rather than asking or coordinating. It responds to the prior request for exact help/options and edge outputs by supplying findings.

evidence.text: Cat/join probes: cat rows skips subsequent headers by default; -n includes them.
Join output repeats key columns (header k,v1,k,v2), duplicate matches cross product; --left/right/full append unmatched padded fields. --cross cartesian.
Table aligns each column left, widths max(content, width default 2), pad default 2; -c N truncates with ... (so width based truncated).
